scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck:packages && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run typecheck:browser
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && npm run fixtures:verify && npm run typecheck:browser && playwright test --grep-invert @performance
scripts.test:media-performance: npm run build && npm run fixtures:verify && npm run typecheck:browser && playwright test test/browser/performance.spec.ts
scripts.playground:build: npm run build && npm run build --prefix examples/api-playground
scripts.playground:test: npm run build && npm run test --prefix examples/api-playground
scripts.playground:validate: npm run playground:build && npm run test --prefix examples/api-playground
scripts.playground:test:browser: npm run build && npm run test:browser --prefix examples/api-playground --
scripts.playground:dev: npm run build && npm run dev --prefix examples/api-playground --
scripts.playground:preview: npm run build && npm run preview --prefix examples/api-playground --
scripts.validate: npm run license:check && npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run typecheck:packages && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run readme:check && vitest run && node scripts/pack-check.mjs && npm run release:check && npm run release-plan:check && node scripts/consumer-check.mjs && npm run playground:lockfile:check
